# Learn English

> > Free, interactive English learning platform offering comprehensive grammar lessons, vocabulary building, and engaging games for learners of all levels.

Learn English provides structured educational resources for English language learners with a focus on grammar fundamentals, vocabulary expansion, and interactive practice activities. The platform covers essential tenses, verb conjugations, and everyday vocabulary through tutorials, exercises, and gamified learning tools.

## Key Topics

- Grammar lessons
- Vocabulary learning
- English tenses
- Simple Present Tense
- Present Continuous Tense
- Future Simple Tense
- Verb conjugation
- Interactive exercises
- Language games
- Free English learning
- Beginner guides
- Grammar tutorials
- Educational resources
- English learners

## Core Learning Hubs

- [Learn English | Learn English for Free](https://www.learnenglish.com): Homepage offering free English learning with vocabulary, grammar, games and interactive activities
- [English Grammar | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/english-grammar): Central grammar reference covering verb tenses, rules, exercises and learning guides
- [English Vocabulary | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/english-vocabulary-page): Main vocabulary learning hub with categories, pronunciation guides and interactive games
- [Games and Activities | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/games-and-activities): Interactive learning tools including memory games, word searches and vocabulary exercises

## Grammar Lessons & Tenses

- [Verb to be (am, is, are) – With Examples and Online Exercises | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/grammar/verb-to-be/learn-verb-to-be-am-is-are/): Beginner grammar guide for verb to be with examples and online practice exercises
- [Simple Present Tense (do-does) – With Usage, Pictures and Example Sentences | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/grammar/simple-present-tense/simple-present-tense-explanation/): Tutorial on Simple Present Tense with do-does usage, examples and visual explanations
- [Present Continuous Tense – With Usage Examples and Pictures | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/grammar/present-continuous-tense/present-continuous-tense-explanation/): Tutorial on Present Continuous Tense with usage examples, pictures and explanations
- [Future Simple Tense (Will) – With Activities Dialogue and Exercises | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/grammar/future-simple-tense/future-simple-tense-explanation/): Guide to Future Simple Tense with will, dialogues, activities and grammar exercises

## Vocabulary Lessons

- [Days Months and Seasons in English 📆 | Learn English](https://www.learnenglish.com/vocabulary/days-months-seasons/learn-days-months-and-seasons-in-english/): Vocabulary lesson on days, months and seasons with calendar-related time expressions
